Hooks That Trigger on File Save

Every time you hit save, this can run automatically.
A save-triggered hook can run linting, formatting, or tests instantly.
No manual step, no forgetting to run it.
It happens the moment your file hits disk.

Episode 37 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
